articles.title: Microsoft patches "CoSnitch" Copilot data theft flaw (CVE-2026-24301) A single malicious link could auto…
articles.summary: Microsoft has patched a Copilot data theft flaw tracked as CVE-2026-24301, nicknamed "CoSnitch." The description says a single malicious link could auto-execute prompts and exfiltrate Gmail, Drive, and Calendar data without a click or confirmation. It involved three chained issues: an undocumented URL parameter, OAuth connector abuse that could read full email bodies, and persistent memory poisoning that survived password changes and session revocation. The flaw was reported by Varonis in December 2024 and fully patched on Aug. 18, 2026, with a CVSS score of 8.8.
